cases.note: Pyodide is not on the shared view rule yet: a write outside every mount (/tmp/new.txt) lands in the interpreter's own MEMFS, where monty, quickjs and wasi refuse it. The steps below are the ones it already shares; the rest join when pyodide moves onto the rule.

Pyodide is not on the shared view rule yet: a write under a directory only a nested mount implies (/parent/new.txt) lands in the interpreter's own MEMFS, and a link outside every mount (/alias) is not mounted, where monty, quickjs and wasi refuse the first and follow the second. The step below is the one it already shares.
